claims.claim: Python's if statement is a compound statement with if, optional elif, and optional else clauses and suites.
An if/elif/else chain evaluates alternatives in order and selects at most one suite.
An else suite runs when no preceding condition in the chain is true.
The Python tutorial describes elif as short for else if and identifies an if/elif sequence as an alternative to switch or case constructs in other languages.
An earlier broad threshold can make a later stricter threshold unavailable in the same chain.
A suite may contain another compound statement, allowing a nested decision.
